answer.explanation: Within 2026-10-22 20:20:21Z to 20:30:21Z, all four functions run cleanly: a window-scoped error/exception/timeout search returned no records, and REPORT lines show normal durations and memory use. Live configuration (memory, timeout, environment variables, concurrency, roles) matches the IaC template for every function. The Uploader's OUTPUT_BUCKET is correct and its app-policy grants s3:PutObject on that bucket. Before the window, the Uploader logged NoSuchBucket errors on PutObject (around 19:45 and up to 20:00:07). Its configuration was then last modified at 20:10:16, and the errors stop after that, so the fault was already resolved before the window opened. The window itself shows no anomaly.
